data.title: TPC Thailand Office unveils 6 investment pillars for growth in the ‘Well-being Economy’
data.description: Bangkok, Aug 25, 2026 — TPC Thailand Office has outlined its business and investment direction under the theme “The Well-being Economy: A New Role for Business Beyond Sustainability,” highlighting an approach that connects business growth with positive impact and supports the transition towards a wellbeing economy through its Six Investment Pillars.

data.title: Executive overhaul in the pipeline
data.description: <p>The cabinet has given the nod to a major reshuffle of 20 senior officials under the Interior Ministry, in what is seen as the biggest personnel overhaul since the Anutin Charnvirakul administration returned to office for its second term.</p>

data.title: Early retirement guidelines for civil servants take shape
data.description: <p>Guidelines for an early retirement scheme for civil servants are expected to be finalised tomorrow before they are submitted to the cabinet, as the government pushes ahead with its broader reform of the public-sector workforce.</p>

data.title: 2 ex-DLA chiefs in crosshairs
data.description: <p>The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has confirmed that two former director-generals of the Department of Local Administration (DLA) are implicated in alleged cheating in the 2025 local government recruitment examination.</p>

data.title: Syrian Kurdish leader dissolves force that spearheaded jihadist fight
data.description: DAMASCUS - The leader of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces, the Washington-backed group at the forefront of the battle against the Islamic State jihadist group, announced their dissolution on Tuesday under a deal with the government.

data.title: Drug-laced vape liquid raises health fears
data.description: <p>The Department of Medical Sciences has warned e-cigarette users of potentially fatal risks after detecting methamphetamine and etomidate in vape liquid for the first time.</p>

data.title: Akha lifestyle on show at 'The Preservation Of Fire'
data.description: <p>Two Akha traditions on the brink of extinction are presented during "The Preservation Of Fire", which is running at Bangkok Kunsthalle until Nov 1.</p>

data.title: Cash mules held after drug probe
data.description: <p>Three people have been arrested after a Bangkok police investigation into online drug activity uncovered a scam network allegedly using cash mules to move money and fund drug purchases.</p>

data.title: Tax incentives to boost U-Tapao project in EEC
data.description: <p>The government will introduce tax incentives and other measures to help speed up the long-delayed U-Tapao Airport and Eastern Aerotropolis development project, with the private sector expected to invest about 1.3 trillion baht over the project's life.</p>

data.title: PM orders probe into copter shooting claim
data.description: <p>Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered an investigation into allegations that security personnel fired on civilians from a helicopter during recent unrest in the southernmost provinces, despite a firm denial from the Fourth Army Region commander.</p>

data.title: FDA approvals boost kingdom's vaccine self-reliance
data.description: <p>Thailand has taken steps to strengthen its vaccine supply, with a nine-strain HPV vaccine and a botulinum antitoxin registered by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).</p>

data.title: Domestic violence in crosshairs
data.description: <p>The cabinet approved a bill yesterday to strengthen protections against domestic violence, according to Social Development and Human Security Minister Nikorn Soemklang.</p>

data.title: Yoshitoshi Shinomiya's debut A New Dawn opening tomorrow at SF Cinema theatres
data.description: <p>Coming-of-age animation A New Dawn opens tomorrow exclusively at SF Cinema theatres.</p>

data.title: Rajavithi opens sexual health clinic
data.description: <p>Rajavithi Hospital has opened a sexual health clinic offering consultations and treatment for sexual health problems, gender-affirming care and HPV-related services.</p>

data.title: Young guns take charge
data.description: <p>The appointment of relatively young civil servants, with many years left in public service, to top bureaucratic posts under Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has drawn attention in political and administrative circles.</p>

data.title: Flood relief budget set at B559m
data.description: <p>The cabinet has approved a central budget of 558.7 million baht to provide relief to those affected by flooding during this year's rainy season.</p>

data.title: New art venue opens with Vasan Sitthiket
data.description: <p>"Dystopia" is the first exhibition at New Orleans x Rebel Art Space, a newly-reopened contemporary hub on Phra Sumen Road, which kicks off this Friday at 5pm and runs until Nov 29.</p>

data.title: Overhead graveyard
data.description: <p>In February, a groom-to-be whose wedding was 10 days away was killed when a cable got tangled around his neck while riding his motorbike home at night in Chachoengsao province.</p>

data.title: People's Party queries B400bn loan plan
data.description: <p>The opposition People's Party (PP) has questioned energy transition plans under a 400-billion-baht government borrowing programme, warning that 200 billion baht of projects could miss their objectives and invite corruption.</p>

data.title: Kingdom in QF as pool winners
data.description: <p>Defending champions Thailand dropped their first set but advanced to the quarter-finals of the AVC Women's Volleyball Continental Championship 2026 as pool winners after they defeated Kazakhstan 3-1 in Tianjin, China, yesterday.</p>

data.title: A train ride with a great who hated to fly
data.description: <p>This week I'm going back to a golfer that many readers probably won't ever have heard of. Neil Coles was a British professional golfer whom I met on a train heading from London in a southerly direction. I know who he was as I had watched him play many times live and on television. A quiet man who had the reputation of being the best fairway wood player, he won many events in his tournament career.</p>

data.title: No fear! Hudson tells Thais
data.description: <p>Thailand are facing a mountain to climb in Hanoi tonight but head coach Anthony Hudson has called on his players to show their bravery as the seven-time champions attempt to overturn Vietnam's 2-0 lead from the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 final.</p>

data.title: Sulaka leaves Port for family reasons
data.description: <p>Port have parted ways with defender Rebin Sulaka on Monday as the Iraq international ended a successful one-year stint at the Thai League 1 club.</p>

data.title: Asia Cup key rehearsal for local riders
data.description: <p>Thailand has declared itself ready to stage one of Asia's premier cycling events, the Track Asia Cup 2026, with a record 38 teams from 21 nations confirmed for the three-day competition at the Huamark Velodrome, starting Friday.</p>

data.title: Canada hits back against Trump’s steep tariffs
data.description: OTTAWA - Canada on Tuesday announced counter-tariffs on US goods ranging between 15% and 50%, intensifying the trade war between the historically close allies.

data.title: Climate change becomes a scorching reality for Europe
data.description: PARIS - For generations, summer in Europe has been languid and dreamy, bringing fine weather and lengthy days on sunny beaches and terraces. But in 2026, the brutal reality of climate change forced its way into daily life.

data.title: At least a quarter of NFL players ‘may get brain disease’
data.description: WASHINGTON - At least a quarter of National Football League players may end up with a degenerative brain disease, according to a new study published Tuesday that lays bare the extreme toll of America’s favourite sport.

data.title: Spain speeds up return of migrants from Ceuta
data.description: MADRID - Spain’s government took steps on Tuesday to speed up the return of thousands of migrants still in the Spanish territory of Ceuta following a mass influx from Morocco in July.

data.title: Iranians queue for petrol as US announces new sanctions
data.description: TEHRAN - Long queues formed at petrol stations in Tehran on Tuesday after the United States announced fresh sanctions aimed at pressuring Iran into submission.
